lines: How do you speak to a father who threatens to stone you? Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, showed us.
O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see, and will not benefit you at all?
His father said: If you do not stop, I will surely stone you.
He answered: Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord.
Speak gently to your parents today... even when it's hard.
The full movie of Prophet Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, comes tonight. Follow so you don't miss it.
